title: GDF15Analysis: continuous likelihood ratio analysis of plasma GDF15 for PVOD
description: Analysis code and reproducibility materials for the study "Continuous Likelihood Ratio Analysis Refines Plasma GDF15 as a Diagnostic Biomarker for Pulmonary Veno-Occlusive Disease". The analysis compares plasma GDF15 in pulmonary veno-occlusive disease with idiopathic and heritable pulmonary arterial hypertension. Archived Figure 1 bootstrap results use seed 20260907, with 4,000 requested resamples, 3,991 accepted fits, and 9 complete-separation exclusions.
